name: search_persons
label: Search persons
description: Searches for shareholders and role holders by name, with fuzzy matching (initial expansion, middle-name dropping). Returns two result sets — shareholders and role persons — each with a stable key you can use in ‘Get person roles’ or ‘Get person shareholdings’. Requires full-search access; minors are filtered out. Birth year is masked to a 4-digit year.

parameters.help: The person's name (at least 2 characters). Fuzzy matched.
parameters.name: q
parameters.label: Name

parameters.help: Max number of results per result set (1–100).
parameters.name: limit
parameters.label: Max number

communication.//: The Limit is documented as 'per result set', and the endpoint returns TWO sets. Each array is therefore sliced to Limit and response.limit allows Limit from EACH — up to 2x Limit bundles in total. 🪤 A single total cap starves one set: with shareholders merged first, a common surname filled the cap and no role_person_id was ever emitted, so 'Get person roles' was unreachable. Simply reversing the order moved the starvation onto shareholders instead — measured, both directions fail. Slicing each set AND raising the response cap is what makes both keys reachable, and it matches the parameter's own documented meaning.
